## What's Changed
* Update logback monorepo to v1.5.37 by @specmatic-builder in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2598
* Add WSDL xsi:type support for XML patterns and SOAP parsing by @joelrosario in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2615
* Support abstract xsi:type handling in WSDL XML parsing by @joelrosario in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2616
* Add WSDL substitution group support by @joelrosario in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2618
* Normalize SOAPAction handling and expand WSDL example coverage by @joelrosario in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2619
* Fix WSDL XML parsing and generation edge cases by @joelrosario in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2620


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/compare/2.49.1...2.50.0
